mapper.select: SELECT * FROM purchase_order_detail WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM purchase_order_detail WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO purchase_order_detail (id, order_id, product_id, product_code, product_name, batch_no, unit_id, unit_name, price, quantity, amount, delivered_qty, received_qty, remark) VALUES (#{id}, #{orderId}, #{productId}, #{productCode}, #{productName}, #{batchNo}, #{unitId}, #{unitName}, #{price}, #{quantity}, #{amount}, #{deliveredQty}, #{receivedQty}, #{remark})
mapper.delete: UPDATE purchase_order_detail SET deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE purchase_order_detail SET deleted = 1 WHERE order_id = #{orderId}
